# Paths whose change publishes a new `jobs` bundle (ADR 0100 W3): deploy.yml
# publish-bundle diffs the merge against the commit the newest bundle was built
# from, by operator/bin/substrate-paths-changed.py, and builds one when any
# path here moved. The bundle holds what the image installs at /opt/medchron
# (the runner venv and the pricing table) and /opt/connectors/smokeball (the
# connector venv), built by operator/templates/jobs-runtime.sh.
#
# These are ALSO image paths until the cut (they are not in
# .github/operator-artifact-paths.txt): every such merge builds an image too,
# and the image keeps its own copy as the fallback.
#
# Glob shapes: as in operator-substrate-paths.txt.

operator/runners/medchron/**
operator/connectors/smokeball/**
operator/connectors/_sdk/**
operator/requirements/medchron.txt
operator/requirements/connector-smokeball.txt
operator/adapter/cost_telemetry/anthropic_pricing.json
# The build itself: a change to how the bundle is built builds a new bundle.
operator/templates/jobs-runtime.sh
scripts/ci-publish-bundle.sh
